Name: VintageCandy's Wallpapers and Floors
Author: Vintagecandyshop
Description:
[b]Hello !
[/b]
I have never remotely posted anything mod related before, but I do retexture things sometimes, and I thought maybe other people would like these wallpapers and floors I designed? Some parts may seem very specific, like the Alice in Wonderland themed parts, but if you want to do an Alice in Wonderland themed farm like me, maybe you'll also enjoy those!

[list]
[*]Requires [b]content patcher ![/b]
[*]Overwrites existing wall & floor textures !
[*]Now with a Alternate Textures version under the optional files ! ( Thanks to corner_goblin for the help. )
[/list]
